title: Eridu, Nasiriyah Museum & Great Ziggurat of Ur
full_text:
Head to Eridu, an ancient sumerian city to the south of Nasiriyah,with it being probably the oldest city within the sumerian civilization.
Visiting the museum of Nasiriyah and Tell el-Ubaid.
After lunch, we will drive to the historical city of Ur to visit the Great Ziggurat of Ur, a UNESCO world heritage site and the former capital of Mesopotamia during the Sumerian time.
The site includes Abraham house, Sholgi palace, and the oldest arch of its kind in the world at the entrance of Dub-Lal-Makh temple.
